decisions.decision: Use ResizeOK + NULL guard for OOM safety in RawDataSendWrite (T-14.3-08 + CR-01 dual closure)
decisions.rationale: WDL_HeapBuf::Resize returns without updating m_size on alloc failure; subsequent Get() returns NULL and memcpy(NULL) is guaranteed UB. ResizeOK returns NULL on failure; treat OOM as send-drop symmetric with queue-full path. Single 14-line edit closed both the T-14.3-08 security threat AND the CR-01 Critical code-review finding.

decisions.decision: Split m_rawdata_sendq_overflows into two atomic counters: overflows (try_push failures) + discards (Pattern C disconnect drain) — WR-03 fix
decisions.rationale: Original implementation bumped the same counter on both true overflow and expected Pattern C discard. This made the post-UAT `GetRawDataSendQueueOverflowCount() == 0` invariant unactionable after any Disconnect/Reconnect cycle. New separate counter `GetRawDataSendQueueDiscardCount()` lets the overflow invariant remain meaningful.

decisions.decision: Manual MINGW case-pattern refinement to add MSYS/CYGWIN coverage
decisions.rationale: Fixer agent's WR-02 fix corrected the quote ordering for MINGW64_NT only. Manual refinement subsequently extended the case arm to also match MSYS_NT-* and CYGWIN_NT-* hosts with the same x86_64 architecture suffix. Strictly broader than the agent's fix.

decisions.decision: IN-03 ldd 'not found' fix uses explicit `grep -q ' => not found'` rather than reshaping the awk pipeline
decisions.rationale: The original awk pipeline (`-F'=>' | '{print $1}'`) reduces `'libfoo.so => not found'` to the bare token `'not'`, which the /usr/local|/opt|/home blocklist doesn't match. Adding a dedicated `grep -q' => not found'` check before the blocklist preserves the existing logic and makes the new gate explicit. Lint-trap shape worth documenting.
